output.answer_markdown: Apple did not report a net loss in fiscal 2023. The passages say net income was $97.0 billion on total net sales of $383.3 billion [3]. Net sales did fall 3% (about $11.0 billion) from 2022. Weakness in foreign currencies more than accounted for the decline, which came mainly from lower Mac and iPhone sales, partly offset by higher Services sales [3].
